name: autoexec_operation_generate_combop
label: Table for Associating Tools with Combinations
description: The combination tool's association table is used for automated queries related to associations and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: combop_id
fields.description: The ID of the combined tool, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.description: Tool ID or custom tool ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the combop_id field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_operation_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the operation_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
